blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Three times the quantity two y minus one, minus the quantity y plus five, plus four times the quantity y minus two.

Distribute all three parts. Three times the quantity two y minus one is six y minus three. The minus sign changes both signs: negative y minus five. And four times the quantity y minus two is four y minus eight.
Collect the y terms: six y minus y plus four y. Six minus one plus four is nine, so nine y.
Now the constants: negative three, minus five, minus eight. Together that is negative sixteen.
So the answer is nine y minus sixteen.
Watch out for these traps. If you keep the five positive after the minus sign, you get nine y minus six. If you change only the sign of the five, you get eleven y minus sixteen.
